title: Understanding Angular Momentum Conservation
text: When the bug moves, the system's angular momentum is conserved. This means that the initial angular momentum of the system (disk + bug) is equal to the final angular momentum.

title: Initial Angular Momentum
text: Calculate the initial angular momentum of the system when the bug is at the edge of the disk. Use the formula: $$L_i=I_{\text{disk}}\cdot\omega_i+m_{\text{bug}}\cdot{}R**{2}\cdot\omega_i$$ where $$I_{\text{disk}}=\frac{1}{2}\cdot{}M\cdot{}R**{2}$$.

title: Final Angular Momentum
text: When the bug is back at the edge, the final angular momentum $$L_f$$ is given by: $$L_f=I_{\text{disk}}\cdot\omega_f+m_{\text{bug}}\cdot{}R**{2}\cdot\omega_f$$.
